PRINCIPLE: Tests should focus on a single behavior with one Arrange-Act-Assert. RATIONALE: Single responsibility improves diagnosability. EVALUATION CRITERIA: compliant if only one Act operation; non-compliant if multiple Acts. DECISION RULES: Count distinct Act operations; if >1 mark non-compliant. The method both calls insere(...) (setup) and pesquisa(...) (query) as explicit method calls; there are two distinct operations executed on the SUT in the body. VERDICT: non-compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Tests must be independent and not rely on execution order. RATIONALE: Enables parallel and order-independent execution. EVALUATION CRITERIA: compliant if tests use local variables or use @Before/@After for setup/teardown. DECISION RULES: No shared mutable state and no numbered test names -> compliant. The test uses only local variables and does not share mutable class/static state. VERDICT: compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Coverage of Normal and Exceptional Flows
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Provide tests for happy path and error cases. RATIONALE: Ensures robustness. EVALUATION CRITERIA: compliant if there are at least two tests per method including exception/error tests; look for assertThrows or @Test(expected=...). DECISION RULES: The class has only this single happy-path-style test and no exception/invalid-input test methods; therefore mark non-compliant. VERDICT: non-compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Tests should check boundary values (0, -1, max, empty). RATIONALE: Many bugs occur at boundaries. EVALUATION CRITERIA: look for zero, -1, Integer.MAX_VALUE, empty strings, etc. DECISION RULES: The test only uses value -858 (a typical negative value) and does not exercise explicit boundaries like 0, -1, MAX; therefore mark non-compliant. VERDICT: non-compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Tests should be self-contained and reuse helpers/constants. RATIONALE: Reduces duplication. EVALUATION CRITERIA: look for helpers or constants; if tests are short and not repetitive they can be compliant. DECISION RULES: The test is short (<10 lines) and there's no repetition within this single test; therefore compliant. VERDICT: compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Detailed Analysis of Size and Complexity
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Keep tests small and low complexity. RATIONALE: Easier to understand and maintain. EVALUATION CRITERIA: tests should be <20 lines and avoid loops/conditionals. DECISION RULES: This test is short, linear, and has no loops or conditionals. VERDICT: compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Assertions should verify multiple properties to detect faults. RATIONALE: Superficial assertions may miss bugs. EVALUATION CRITERIA: compliant if >=2 meaningful assertions or collection size+contents, non-compliant if only one superficial assert. DECISION RULES: The test contains a single assertSame and no additional property checks; therefore non-compliant. VERDICT: non-compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Avoid @Ignore/@Disabled or commented-out tests. RATIONALE: Ignored tests hide regressions. EVALUATION CRITERIA: search for @Ignore/@Disabled or commented-out @Test. DECISION RULES: No @Ignore/@Disabled or commented-out tests are present; test is active. VERDICT: compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Link tests to requirements. RATIONALE: Enables coverage tracking. EVALUATION CRITERIA: annotations or Javadoc containing requirement IDs. DECISION RULES: The class Javadoc includes 'REQ-001: basic binary tree operations' so traceability is present. VERDICT: compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Rigorous Use of Performance and Security Tests
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Performance/security tests are separate concerns. RATIONALE: Unit tests normally don't cover these. EVALUATION CRITERIA: look for @Test(timeout=...), timing code or security checks. DECISION RULES: This unit test contains no performance/security assertions and the class name doesn't indicate it should be a performance test. Mark as not-applicable. VERDICT: not-applicable.

PRINCIPLE: Test names should describe scenario and expected outcome. RATIONALE: Improves readability and debugging. EVALUATION CRITERIA: names like method_condition_result or when_then patterns are compliant; generic names are non-compliant. DECISION RULES: The method name 'test13' is generic and not descriptive, so non-compliant. VERDICT: non-compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Small Footprint of Test Code Generation
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Avoid verbose autogenerated tests and names. RATIONALE: Generated tests can be noisy and hard to maintain. EVALUATION CRITERIA: look for auto-generated comments, generated names (test0/test1), or the EvoSuite runner usage. DECISION RULES: The test retains an auto-generated style name ('test13') and the class uses EvoRunner/EvoSuite imports; this indicates generation artifacts, so non-compliant. VERDICT: non-compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Complete Prioritization of Test Case Design
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Tests should show design intent (Given-When-Then or BDD naming). RATIONALE: Improves coverage and clarity. EVALUATION CRITERIA: look for Given-When-Then comments or BDD-style names or multiple scenario coverage. DECISION RULES: The method lacks Given-When-Then comments and only covers a single basic scenario; mark non-compliant. VERDICT: non-compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Responsible Addition of Test Code Maintenance
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Tests should focus on public behavior and avoid implementation details. RATIONALE: Reduces brittleness. EVALUATION CRITERIA: look for reflection or direct access to internals. DECISION RULES: No reflection or private-field access is present; test interacts via public API only. VERDICT: compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Assertions should be specific and include descriptive messages. RATIONALE: Messages aid diagnosis. EVALUATION CRITERIA: compliant if assertions include messages or use specific assertEquals/assertThat; non-compliant if only bare assertions without messages or generic assertTrue. DECISION RULES: The test uses a single assertSame without a failure message; therefore mark non-compliant. VERDICT: non-compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Comments should explain why not what. RATIONALE: Minimal useful comments are acceptable. EVALUATION CRITERIA: look for excessive commented-out code or too many comments. DECISION RULES: No commented-out code and class-level Javadoc provides context; inline code is minimal and self-explanatory. VERDICT: compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Tests must be deterministic (no random/time/external dependencies). RATIONALE: Avoid flaky tests. EVALUATION CRITERIA: check for Random(), System.currentTimeMillis(), Thread.sleep(), external calls. DECISION RULES: The test uses deterministic operations with no random/time/external dependencies. VERDICT: compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Complete Avoidance of Test Side Effects
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Tests should not leave persistent side effects or modify shared state. RATIONALE: Avoids inter-test interference. EVALUATION CRITERIA: look for file/db writes or static modifications without cleanup. DECISION RULES: Test only manipulates in-memory local objects and does not persist or modify static state; no cleanup required. VERDICT: compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Suitable Utilization of Test Labels and Categories
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Use categories/tags to organize tests. RATIONALE: Enables selective execution. EVALUATION CRITERIA: look for @Tag or @Category. DECISION RULES: The class is annotated with @Category(UnitTest.class), so tests are categorized. VERDICT: compliant.
